topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It outlines the lecture's focus on cancer evolution, microenvironmental influences, and the core learning objectives.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how successive genetic mutations and epigenetic modifications confer selective advantages to drive clonal expansion.

topics.label: Cell of origin and stem cell hierarchy in cancer initiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how normal tissue hierarchies and stemness properties determine tumor initiation and propagation capacity across different cancer models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory promotion of tumor outgrowth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how external environmental promoters, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stroma cooperate with mutations to permit neoplastic progression.

topics.label: Methods for analyzing tumor heterogeneity and spatial organization
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the single-cell sequencing and spatial omics technologies used to investigate tumor evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Integrated multifactorial model of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how genetic mutations, cell-of-origin characteristics, epigenetic plasticity, and microenvironmental coevolution converge to produce malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
